written_by: Claude under the author's overnight delegation (18/11/2026), before any test-day computation
test_days: every test weekday in data_manifest.json test_dates that passes the phase-A exclusion rule (complete day, warmup available); expected 50

pipelines_locked.Hybrid: M0 costs + h * s_hat_pooled added to Switch

s_hat_S_rule: mean of per-day s_hat over train days of stratum S (day_statistics.csv; strata from day_train/day_utilizations.csv peak_utilization x 23128.606845556/12544.525173885 < 1 for both actions)
stratum_rule: S iff, for both actions, max over window slots and links of the 15-min offered-load utilization (real matrix, no modulation) is < 1 at capacity_Mbps; else O
evaluable_rule: C_ref(h)/h >= 12.544525 Mbit (mean total backlog >= 1 ms of service at capacity_Mbps)

H1.population: DAY1+DAY2, stratum S, evaluable, h in {2,4,6} h, tau in {300,900}

H2.population: DAY1+DAY2, stratum S, evaluable, h in {2,4,6} h, tau in {300,900}
H2.statistic: Hybrid both-side regret max(R_fresh, R_stale_tau) <= 0.5 percent of C_ref

H3.population: H2 population restricted to cases with M0 both-side regret > 0.5 percent
H3.statistic: Hybrid both-side regret < M0 both-side regret

G_S_definition: L_stale - L_fresh (letter Eq. metrics); negative means fresher telemetry hurts
se_definition: sample sd over instances of V[i,a_stale]-V[i,a_fresh] divided by sqrt(N)
